description: PAID $0.05 USDC. Returns X-Stream-Token covering /v1/stream/trades, /v1/stream/positions, and /v1/stream/meme/trades for 15 minutes. Day ($2) and month ($25) passes already include these streams. No new card SKU. Research only. Returns JSON with an X-Stream-Token that covers the majors, positions, and meme SSE routes for 15 minutes.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].
